name: Urban Extension Road II

timeline.event: Proposed as an urban extension road in Delhi's Master Plan 2021
Inaugurated by the Prime Minister (17 August), along with the Delhi section of the Dwarka Expressway

history: Urban Extension Road II works like a third ring road for Delhi, sweeping around the city's western side from Alipur in the north to the airport area in the south. It was first sketched out in Delhi's Master Plan 2021 and built years later by NHAI as National Highway 344M. It lets traffic from north India reach Gurugram, the airport and Rajasthan without squeezing through central Delhi. The Prime Minister opened it in August 2025.
facts: Officially National Highway 344M, but everyone calls it UER-II.
Acts as Delhi's third ring road, after the Ring Road and the Outer Ring Road.
Connects NH 44 at Alipur with NH 48 near the airport, crossing the Rohtak road at Mundka.
Spur roads link it to Sonipat and Bahadurgarh in Haryana.
About 75 km long, of which the main stretch runs entirely inside Delhi.
